Rajasthan High Court Stenographer Recruitment 2026: Rajasthan High Court, Jodhpur has invited online applications for Stenographer Grade-III (Hindi/English) posts in District Courts and Stenographer Grade-II (Hindi) posts in District Legal Service Authorities, including Permanent Lok Adalats. The Rajasthan High Court Stenographer Notification includes Grade-III and Grade-II Stenographer posts. Applicants seeking a stenographer job in Rajasthan Courts can submit their application form after checking the prescribed educational qualification, computer qualification, age limit and other eligibility conditions.

Rajasthan High Court Stenographer Recruitment 2026 PDF

Are you also waiting for Rajasthan High Court Stenographer Recruitment 2026? Rajasthan High Court, Jodhpur has released Advertisement No. RAJ.HC/Exam Cell/Subordinate Judiciary/Stenography/2026/1032 for 163 vacant positions. Candidates can check complete details such as application dates, educational qualification, age limit, application fee, salary, vacancy distribution, selection process and examination pattern below.

Rajasthan High Court Stenographer Notification 2026 Overview

Important Dates

Rajasthan High Court has released the complete application schedule for Stenographer Recruitment 2026. Candidates must complete the online application and fee payment within the prescribed dates. Applicants are advised not to wait until the closing date because the application and payment links will become inactive after the respective deadlines.

Age Limit as on 01/01/2027

Application Fee

Rajasthan High Court Stenographer Recruitment 2026 Qualification

  • Passed Senior Secondary (10+2) in Arts, Science or Commerce from the Rajasthan Board or any equivalent recognized board, or possess a higher qualification.
  • Must have good working knowledge of Hindi written in Devanagari script and knowledge of Rajasthani dialects.
  • Must possess any one of the following computer qualifications:
  • DOEACC/NIELIT “O” Level or Higher Level Certificate.
  • COPA/DPCS Certificate issued under NCVT/SCVT.
  • Diploma in Computer Science / Computer Application.
  • Diploma in Computer Science & Engineering.
  • RSCIT Certificate.
  • Senior Secondary with Computer Science as an optional subject.
  • Any equivalent or higher computer qualification recognized by the Government.
  • Candidates must be mentally and physically fit and must submit a medical fitness certificate from a Government-notified medical authority when required.
  • A candidate must be a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal or a subject of Bhutan. Candidates belonging to Nepal or Bhutan must possess the required eligibility certificate issued by the Government of India.

Rajasthan High Court Stenographer Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

Rajasthan High Court Stenographer Recruitment 2026 Salary

  • During Probation: Selected candidates will receive fixed consolidated remuneration of ₹23,700 per month for two years as Probationer Trainees.
  • After Successful Completion of Probation: Candidates will be placed in Pay Matrix Level L-10 with a pay scale of ₹33,800 to ₹1,06,700 per month.
  • Probation Period: Two Years.

Rajasthan High Court Stenographer Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • Stage 1 – Shorthand Test: Candidates must appear for the Hindi or English Shorthand Test according to the post for which they have applied.
  • English Shorthand Test: Dictation of a passage for 6 minutes at 80 words per minute, followed by transcription and typing on a computer within 50 minutes.
  • Hindi Shorthand Test: Dictation of a passage for 6 minutes at 70 words per minute, followed by transcription and typing on a computer within 50 minutes.
  • Stage 2 – Computer Test: A compulsory Speed Test and Efficiency Test will be conducted for all candidates. Each test will carry 50 marks and have a duration of 10 minutes.
  • Minimum Computer Speed: Candidates must achieve at least 8,000 key depressions per hour.
  • Computer Test Font: Kruti Dev 010 for Hindi and Calibri for English.
  • Stage 3 – Interview: Successful candidates will be called for a qualifying interview. The interview will carry no marks and will be conducted to ensure that the candidate has no speech impediment that prevents them from reading their own writing.
  • Final Merit List: The merit list will be prepared based on aggregate marks obtained in the Shorthand Test and Computer Test.
  • Tie-Breaking Rule: In case of equal aggregate marks, the candidate securing higher marks in the Shorthand Test will receive a higher rank. If the tie continues, the older candidate will be placed higher in merit.

How to Apply for Rajasthan High Court Stenographer Recruitment 2026

  • Visit the official website of Rajasthan High Court at hcraj.nic.in.
  • Open the recruitment section and carefully read the detailed advertisement and online application instructions.
  • Complete the online registration process between 22 July 2026 at 01:00 PM and 10 August 2026 at 05:00 PM.
  • Fill in all required personal, educational, category and communication details correctly.
  • Select up to five preferred District Judgeships in the required order of preference.
  • Upload a recent photograph bearing the candidate’s name and date of photograph, a valid photo identity document, signed declaration, live photograph, Hindi and English signatures, and left thumb impression.
  • Pay the applicable examination fee through e-Mitra Kiosk, Citizen Service Centre, Net Banking, Debit Card or Credit Card by 11 August 2026 at 05:00 PM.
  • Review all entered details carefully before final submission because changes will not be permitted after the application is finally submitted.
  • Submit the application form before the closing date.
  • Save and take a printout of the submitted application form and fee receipt for future reference.
  • Download the admit card from the official website after its release. Admit cards will not be sent through post.

Rajasthan High Court Stenographer Recruitment 2026 Important Links

Rajasthan High Court Stenographer Recruitment 2026 Important FAQs

What is the Apply Date for Rajasthan High Court Stenographer Recruitment 2026?

The online application process will start on 22 July 2026 at 01:00 PM. The last date to submit the application form is 10 August 2026 at 05:00 PM. The examination fee can be paid until 11 August 2026 at 05:00 PM.

What is the Exam Fee for Rajasthan High Court Stenographer Vacancy 2026?

The application fee is ₹750 for General, Creamy Layer OBC/MBC and other-state candidates; ₹600 for Rajasthan OBC/MBC Non-Creamy Layer and EWS candidates; and ₹450 for Rajasthan SC, ST, Persons with Disabilities and Ex-Servicemen candidates.

How Many Vacancies Are Available in Rajasthan High Court Stenographer Recruitment 2026?

A total of 163 vacancies have been announced for Stenographer Grade-III Hindi/English and Stenographer Grade-II Hindi posts in Non-TSP and TSP areas.

What is the Eligibility to Apply for Rajasthan High Court Stenographer Recruitment 2026?

Candidates must have passed Senior Secondary in Arts, Science or Commerce, or an equivalent or higher examination. They must possess good working knowledge of Hindi written in Devanagari script, knowledge of Rajasthani dialects and one of the prescribed computer qualifications such as DOEACC “O” Level, COPA/DPCS, RSCIT, Diploma in Computer Science/Computer Application or an equivalent qualification.

PNB Local Bank Officer Notification 2026

Candidates must submit the online application form according to the prescribed dates. Applicants are advised to complete registration and fee payment without waiting for the closing date.

Age Limit as on 01/07/2026

Application Fee

Bank transaction charges must be paid by the candidate. The application fee is non-refundable and cannot be reserved for another examination or selection.

PNB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026 Qualification

Educational Qualification

  • Local Bank Officer (LBO): Candidate should possess a Graduate degree in any discipline from a University or Institution recognized or approved by the Government of India or its regulatory bodies. The candidate must possess a valid mark sheet or degree certificate confirming graduate status on the date of online registration and must enter the percentage of marks obtained in Graduation.

Experience, Local Language and Application Requirements

  • Post-Qualification Experience: Candidate must possess a minimum of one year of post-qualification work experience in Clerical or Officer Cadre in a Scheduled Commercial Bank or Regional Rural Bank listed in the Second Schedule of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934. The experience must be counted after completion of Graduation and must be available as on 09/08/2026.
  • Local-Language Requirement: Candidate must be proficient in reading, writing and speaking the mandatory local language of the state for which the application is submitted. Candidates who have not studied that language as a subject in Class 10 or Class 12 will be required to qualify the Local Language Proficiency Test.
  • Application Restriction: A candidate may apply for a vacancy in only one state. Applying for more than one state is not permitted.

PNB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

State-Wise Vacancy Details

PwBD reservation is horizontal. The number of vacancies is provisional and may change according to the requirements of Punjab National Bank. Candidates may apply for only one state, and the merit list will be prepared state-wise and category-wise.

PNB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026 Salary

  • Local Bank Officer (LBO): Rs. 48,480-2,000/7-62,480-2,340/2-67,160-2,680/7-85,920 under Junior Management Grade Scale-I.
  • In addition to Basic Pay, selected candidates will be entitled to Dearness Allowance, City Compensatory Allowance, House Rent Allowance or leased accommodation, Leave Fare Concession, Medical Insurance, retirement benefits and other perquisites according to Bank rules.
  • Eligible selected candidates having prior completed service as an Officer in a Scheduled Commercial Bank may receive one advance increment for each completed year of eligible service, subject to a maximum of two increments and fulfilment of the prescribed job-profile conditions.

PNB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • Stage 1 – Online Written Test
  • Stage 2 – Screening of Application and Documents
  • Stage 3 – Local Language Proficiency Test, wherever applicable
  • Stage 4 – Personal Interview

The Online Written Test consists of Reasoning and Computer Aptitude, Data Analysis and Interpretation, English Language, Quantitative Aptitude and General/Economy/Banking Awareness. One-fourth of the marks assigned to a question will be deducted for each incorrect answer.

Candidates who studied the prescribed local language as a subject in Class 10 or Class 12 may be exempted from the Local Language Proficiency Test, subject to submission of valid documentary evidence.

Final selection will be based on combined performance in the Online Written Test and Personal Interview, subject to qualifying the Local Language Proficiency Test wherever applicable. The final merit list will be prepared state-wise and category-wise.

How to Apply for PNB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026

  • Visit the Punjab National Bank official website at https://pnb.bank.in/ and open the Recruitment/Career section.
  • Open the Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026 application link and read the official notification carefully.
  • Click on “CLICK HERE FOR NEW REGISTRATION” and enter the required basic details.
  • Use the generated Provisional Registration Number and Password to complete the application form.
  • Enter personal, educational, experience, category, state and local-language details carefully.
  • Upload the photograph, signature, left-hand thumb impression, handwritten declaration and prescribed supporting documents.
  • Verify all information by using the “SAVE AND NEXT” option before completing registration.
  • Pay the applicable application fee through the online payment gateway.
  • Submit the application form on or before 09/08/2026.
  • Download and print the submitted application form and e-receipt for future reference.
  • Do not send the printed application form or documents to Punjab National Bank by post.

Applications are accepted through online mode only. No other application mode will be accepted.

PNB LBO Recruitment 2026 Important Links

PNB Recruitment 2026 Important FAQs

What is the Apply Date for PNB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026?

The starting date for online registration is 20/07/2026 and the last date is 09/08/2026.

What is the Exam Fee for PNB Local Bank Officer Recruitment Vacancy 2026?

The application fee is Rs. 59/- inclusive of GST for SC, ST and PwBD candidates. For all other candidates, the fee is Rs. 1180/- inclusive of GST. Bank transaction charges are payable separately.

How many vacancies will be there in PNB Local Bank Officer Recruitment Vacancy 2026?

There are a total of 545 Local Bank Officer vacancies distributed across 17 states.

What is the Eligibility to apply for PNB Local Bank Officer 2026?

Candidates must possess a Graduate degree in any discipline and a minimum of one year of post-qualification work experience in Clerical or Officer Cadre in an eligible Scheduled Commercial Bank or Regional Rural Bank. They must also be proficient in reading, writing and speaking the mandatory local language of the state for which they apply.

  • Technician Apprentice (Diploma): Rs. 10,900 per month or as per prescribed rates; 50% is paid by RSP and 50% by BOPT under DBT mode.
  • Training Benefits: The apprenticeship duration is one year. RSP will not provide accommodation or travel allowance during training.

Application Fee

PTET 2023 Eligibility

B.Ed. Course (Two Year Course):

  • Candidates securing at least 50% marks in aggregate in the Bachelor’s / Master’s Degree examination of any State University or any other University recognized as equivalent to and fulfilling the other requirements for admission to B.Ed.
  • However, Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes, MBC as well as physically challenged and Widow or Divorced women candidates of Rajasthan having at least 45% marks in aggregate in the Bachelor’s or Master’s degree level examination will be eligible to apply for admission.

B.A. B.Ed./ B.Sc. B.Ed. (4 Year Course):

  • Candidate securing at least 50% marks in aggregate in the Senior secondary examination of the Sec. Board of education, Rajasthan Ajmer, or any other recognized Board as equivalent (Equivalence certificate should be provided by the candidate)
  • However, scheduled caste, scheduled tribes, other backward classes, most backward classes as well as physically challenged and widow or divorced women candidates of Rajasthan having at least 45% marks in aggregate in the Senior Secondary examination will be eligible to apply for admission.

PTET 2023 Online Form Exam Pattern

  • All questions in Question-Paper shall be objective-type multiple-choice questions with at least four alternative answers. (See sample question under heading ‘Model Question Paper’).
  • The Paper will be set both in English and Hindi except in the Language Proficiency Section.
  • In case of discrepancy in options of answers or in the question paper, the English version shall be treated as final.
  • The duration of the paper shall be 3 hours.
  • Each question will carry 3 marks and the maximum marks in the paper shall be 600.
  • Full 3 marks will be awarded for each correct answer. In Attitude & Aptitude Section, however, the answers will be scaled on a scale of 3 to 0 marks. This means that answer to each question will carry a weightage of 3,2,1 and 0.
  • The PTET Examination will consist of one question paper containing the following four Sections:
  1. Mental Ability
  2. Teaching attitude & Aptitude Test
  3. General Awareness and
  4. Language Proficiency (Hindi or English)

PTET 2023 Syllabus

Section A: Mental ability:

  • Mental ability Section shall consist of 50 objective type multiple choice questions to test the following abilities:
  • Reasoning (ii) Imagination (iii) Judgement & Decision Making (iv) Creative Thinking (v) Generalization (vi) Drawing inferences etc.

Section B: Teaching Attitude and Aptitude Test:

  • Teaching Attitude and Aptitude Test Section shall consist of 50 questions mainly in the following areas:
  • Social Maturity, (ii) Leadership, (iii) Professional Commitment, (iv) interpersonal Relations. (v) Communication, (vi) Awareness etc. This will be the test of attitudes and awareness in which answers to the questions will be scored on a scale of 3, 2, 1, and 0.

Section C: General awareness:

  • General awareness Section shall consist of 50 objective type multiple choice questions mainly in the following areas:
  • Current Affairs (National & International), (ii) (Indian History & Culture, (iii) India and its Natural Resources. (iv) Great Indian Personalities (Past and Present), (v) Environmental Awareness, (vi) Knowledge about Rajasthan, etc.

Section D: Language Proficiency (English or Hindi):

  • Language Proficiency (English or Hindi) Section shall consist of 50 Objective type multiple choice questions regarding proficiency in Hindi or English Language mainly related to the following aspects:-
  • Vocabulary, (ii) Functional Grammar, (iii) Sentence Structures, (iv) Comprehension, etc.

  • However, as far as possible, information will be given through S.M.S. on the mobile number given by the candidate in their online admission form.
  • Notification regarding declaration of result on Website will be published in newspapers for information of candidates.
  • The material related to the examination will be kept preserved for six months after the examination. Thereafter, the material will be disposed of.
